info.title: Spider-Man IEEE Event Platform API
info.description:
REST API for the Spider-Man themed IEEE event platform.

Auth uses HTTP-only cookies: `spm_access_token` (player) and `spm_admin_token` (admin). Player and admin routes are marked with the matching cookie security scheme. See `docs/frontend.md` (integration guide) and `docs/api.md` (full reference).
